entities.summary: Julius Schnorr von Carolsfeld was a German painter, chiefly of Biblical subjects. As a young man he associated with the painters of the Nazarene movement who revived the florid Renaissance style in religious art. He is remembered for his extensive Picture Bible, and his designs for stained glass windows in cathedrals. Julius Schnorr von Carolsfeld was a writers & intellectuals from Leipzig (1794-03-26, Leipzig–1872-05-24). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
